categories.main_business_segments: Jiangyin Haida Rubber and Plastic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: rubber and plastic products, and aluminum products. The rubber and plastic segment focuses on sealing and vibration reduction components for high-end equipment, serving industries such as rail transit, automotive, construction, and shipping. The aluminum segment, mainly through its subsidiary Konuo Precision, specializes in high-precision automotive sunroof guide rails and other industrial aluminum extrusion products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced rubber modification technologies and multi-field integration strategies to develop sealing and vibration reduction products. It employs customized production based on sales orders, with specialized divisions managing production. Konuo Precision utilizes core technologies including aluminum liquid purification, extrusion with liquid nitrogen cooling, hardness deviation control, high-precision dimension control, mold development, and rapid profile inspection to produce high-quality aluminum extrusions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major players in rail transit (high-speed trains, metro systems), automotive manufacturers (including OEMs like Webasto, Aisin, BYD, Geely, Volvo, and others), construction companies for building seals, and shipping companies for container sealing components. The company also serves emerging markets in new energy sectors such as photovoltaic and hydrogen storage materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales accounting for over 90% of revenue. It has expanding overseas operations including a factory in Romania and exports to North America and Europe. Its aluminum products serve global automotive brands, and it maintains international customer relationships in automotive and rail sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangyin Haida operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying specialized rubber, plastic, and aluminum components to OEMs and system integrators. It procures raw materials like rubber and aluminum ingots from upstream suppliers and delivers finished components downstream to end manufacturers and assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation with sustained R&D investment focused on green development, new material development, and performance enhancement. It collaborates with universities and research institutes on projects such as life prediction, low-temperature vulcanization, and EPDM recycling. Strategic R&D priorities include developing advanced sealing systems, lightweight aluminum components, automotive vibration reduction parts, and new energy materials aligned with carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized rubber, plastic, and aluminum products to OEMs and system integrators. Sales are contract-based, often involving framework agreements and project-specific orders. The company also earns government subsidies related to innovation and environmental initiatives, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's rubber sealing and vibration reduction market, recognized as a top 10 enterprise in the rubber products industry. Its aluminum extrusion subsidiary is among the largest specialized suppliers of automotive sunroof guide rails domestically. It competes with both domestic and international suppliers by leveraging technology, quality, and comprehensive customer service to maintain industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.31 billion, a 20.88% increase over the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 161.7 million, up 19.53%. Total assets reached RMB 3.85 billion, growing 7.11%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding production capacity and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangyin Haida differentiates itself through advanced proprietary rubber formulations, integrated sealing and vibration reduction solutions, and high-precision aluminum extrusion technologies. It emphasizes product durability, environmental compliance, and customization capabilities. The company’s multi-field integration strategy and strong R&D partnerships enable it to offer innovative, high-quality components that meet stringent performance and regulatory standards, supporting customers in high-end rail, automotive, construction, and new energy sectors.
